name: ivyhouse-terminal-orchestrator
description: [DEPRECATED] Legacy combined extension. Use ivyhouse-terminal-injector + ivyhouse-terminal-monitor.

commands.title: [DEPRECATED] IvyHouse Legacy: Start Codex + OpenCode Terminals

[DEPRECATED] IvyHouse Legacy: Send Text to OpenCode Terminal

ivyhouseTerminalOrchestrator.autoStart.description: Automatically start Codex and OpenCode terminals on VS Code startup.

ivyhouseTerminalOrchestrator.codexComman.description: Command sent via terminal.sendText to start Codex CLI.

ivyhouseTerminalOrchestrator.opencodeCom.description: Command sent via terminal.sendText to start OpenCode.

ivyhouseTerminalOrchestrator.codexTermin.description: Name of the dedicated Codex terminal.

ivyhouseTerminalOrchestrator.opencodeTer.description: Name of the dedicated OpenCode terminal.

ivyhouseTerminalOrchestrator.captureMaxS.description: Max seconds to capture terminal output after sending a command.

ivyhouseTerminalOrchestrator.captureSile.description: Stop capturing when no new terminal output arrives for this long (ms).

ivyhouseTerminalOrchestrator.captureMaxB.description: Max bytes to write into a single capture file.

ivyhouseTerminalOrchestrator.captureDir.description: Workspace-relative directory to store terminal captures (should be gitignored).

ivyhouseTerminalOrchestrator.workflowPol.description: Workflow loop: interval (ms) to poll log files for markers.

ivyhouseTerminalOrchestrator.workflowMax.description: Workflow loop: maximum number of QA rounds before auto-stop.

ivyhouseTerminalOrchestrator.workflowAsk.description: Workflow loop: when QA FAIL reaches max rounds, either print a structured prompt and wait for /workflow/decision API (batch / ask_questions), or use ask_questions mode (interactive is an alias for ask_questions; no longer uses QuickPick).

ivyhouseTerminalOrchestrator.workflowTim.description: Workflow loop: total timeout (ms) before auto-stop (default: 30 minutes).

ivyhouseTerminalOrchestrator.workflowTai.description: Workflow loop: keep only the last N lines in compact engineer_/qa_ tail logs. Raw logs may still grow.

ivyhouseTerminalOrchestrator.workflowRea.description: Workflow loop: wait up to this many ms for Codex/OpenCode TUI to become ready (detected from raw transcript tail) before sending prompts.
Workflow loop: polling interval (ms) for ready detection based on transcript tail.
Workflow loop: when raw transcript remains empty, assume terminal is ready after this many ms (0 disables).

ivyhouseTerminalOrchestrator.workflowRes.description: Workflow loop: when true, dispose and restart the Codex/OpenCode terminals before starting (safer for script capture, but disruptive for interactive TUIs).

ivyhouseTerminalOrchestrator.workflowAll.description: Workflow loop: allow fallback to `script -c` capture when Proposed API terminalDataWriteEvent is unavailable. Disabled by default to avoid polluting interactive TUIs.

ivyhouseTerminalOrchestrator.workflowSen.description: Workflow loop: number of retries when prompt injection shows no weak ACK (transcript unchanged).
Workflow loop: time (ms) to wait for a weak ACK after sendText (raw log size or tail fingerprint changes).
Workflow loop: delay (ms) between send retries.

ivyhouseTerminalOrchestrator.workflowPri.description: Workflow loop: before sending a prompt, send N blank lines to help focus input in some TUIs.

ivyhouseTerminalOrchestrator.workflowPro.description: When true, Workflow Loop will automatically prompt to clear `.service/terminal_capture` after detecting QA PASS and the associated `.agent/logs/<Idx-XXX>_log.md` exists. Set to false to disable automatic prompt.

ivyhouseTerminalOrchestrator.workflowPos.description: Workflow loop: delay (ms) after injecting the prompt before sending extra Enter keystrokes (workflowPostSendEnterCount). Set to 0 to disable.
Workflow loop: number of extra Enter keystrokes sent after the prompt inject delay. Helps ensure TUI acceptance of the injected text. Set to 0 to disable.

ivyhouseTerminalOrchestrator.workflowQaE.description: Workflow loop: maximum characters of the engineer/QA tail summary injected into the next-role prompt. Truncated at head if exceeded.

ivyhouseTerminalOrchestrator.sendtextBri.description: Enable the local HTTP bridge server (sendtext bridge) that accepts /send, /status, and /stop-workflow requests.
Host/IP the sendtext bridge HTTP server binds to. Default is loopback-only (127.0.0.1) for security.
TCP port the sendtext bridge HTTP server listens on.
Maximum size (bytes) of the `text` field in a single /send request. Requests exceeding this are rejected with HTTP 413.
Maximum total size (bytes) of the HTTP request body accepted by the bridge. Requests exceeding this are rejected with HTTP 413.
Sustained rate limit (requests per second) for the sendtext bridge. Set to 0 to disable rate limiting.
Burst allowance (number of requests) above the sustained rate limit for the sendtext bridge. Set to 0 to disable burst.
